items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I’m from the Elvin Jones school of perspiration... youngsters today, they’ll start with maybe Elvin Jones... I love them all.

ctx.x: You have to have two sets of clothes for before the gig and after the gig.

No I usually, if I work real hard, I might drop 3-4 pounds in an evening. It’s like I like to tell people that I’m from the Gene Krupa, Buddy Rich, Louis Bellson school of drumming, but I’m from the Elvin Jones school of perspiration, cause I do sweat a lot.
That’s saying something. Were you a typical bang-on-the-pots-and-pans-in-the-kitchen little kid?

items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I recall you came for your interview right after walking off an upbeat set of music and you described yourself as a charter member of the Elvin Jones school of perspiration. That’s very true.

ctx.x: Yeah. I remember that was Don and Sue Miller’s Jazz party in Paradise Valley, yeah.
And I recall you came for your interview right after walking off an upbeat set of music and you described yourself as a charter member of the Elvin Jones school of perspiration.

That’s very true. That was my introductory line because I used to — shall we say for the genteel crowd, I would perspire quite a bit. I don’t seem to do that that much anymore because I don’t seem to have much occasion to play that hard anymore.
